english.description: Do not wake up ICEY
Do not activate the photon bridge and jump 3 times into the ravine
Keep trying to go left in the "extra area"
Jump into sewage 3 times
Learn the name of God
Finish the story in the "Totally Empty Room"
Wait for a few minutes in the "Totally Empty Room"
Earn a bronze trophy in the "Totally Empty Room"
Earn a silver trophy in the "Totally Empty Room"
Witness secrets of development in the "Archive Room"
Ignore the narrator and enter Emberville before the gate closes
And in the dark of night, the unfathomable Black Star rises
Select "Not Ready" before the final battle
Enter level "Shio"
Earn sponsorship for the game
Discover the truth of ICEY's birth
Destroy the background music player
Confront the Yellow King in the monitor room
Encourage the narrator to meet the tip of a bullet
Do not kill Dahal's self which lives within Trinity
Break open Pandora's box
Witness the birth of ICEY's self-awareness
Enter the real "game" with the narrator

Defeat Trinity
Trinity could not stop this cycle, nor can she ever stop the wheel of reincarnation from spinning.

Defeat Gorger
Gorger was a simple resident of Ultimopolis that sacrificed himself to Judas without regret... or any other feelings.

Defeat Thor
Thor understood Judas' ultimate goal, and paid the ultimate price of splitting his self to serve Judas.

Defeat Parker
Parker, betrayed by Judas, retreated with no conscience to the dark corners of the metro.

Defeat Carlos
Carlos was fed up with the constant sacrifice of his self in each reincarnation. His solution? Kill and replace the Chosen One.

Defeat Jack
While Jack's faith is unwavering, being banished to the furthest corner of the world left him unable to even come close to the Chosen One.

Defeat Ideon
Ideon's self was slowly destroyed through the process of never-ending reincarnation, leaving him even more vulnerable to Judas' manipulation.

Defeat Dahal
Only in a virtual world is such a thing possible... To mix two beings' memories... Because of this, Dahal short-circuited.

Defeat Trinity
Even after her memories were mixed with another's, Trinity still tried to prevent the birth of the Chosen One. That was, of course, futile.

Defeat Judas
Judas had long ago given up his struggle. As he ascended the Clock Tower, the Black Star rose once more.

击败崔妮蒂
崔妮蒂最终还是没能阻止这次的轮回，她永远也无法阻止轮回的开始

击败暴食
暴食就是弥城居民的典型，向犹大献上自我，不再思考直到麻木

击败托尔
也有了解到犹大的真正目的，而自愿献上自我的人，比如托尔。他自愿将自我分裂，交给犹大

击败帕克
父亲犹大的背叛，令帕克彻底放弃了思考，蜷缩在漆黑的地铁黑暗角落

击败卡洛斯
卡洛斯受够了不断轮回献上自我的过程，他决定要代替神选之子获得她收集的所有自我

击败杰克
杰克的信仰从未改变，但被放逐的他却不一定能碰触到神选之子

击败伊汀
伊汀的自我在轮回中消磨殆尽，只剩下驱壳被犹大所操纵。

击败达哈尔
正是因为只有在虚拟的世界中才能做得到这种事——让两人记忆互换——达哈尔因此崩溃

击败崔妮蒂
崔妮蒂即使在记忆遭到互换后，仍然尝试着阻止神选之子的诞生，但仍然是徒劳

击败犹大
犹大早已放弃最后的挣扎，倒吊于塔顶的他，看到的仍然是升起的黑星
